Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in

Class KfePsbtWorkflowService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.KfePsbtWorkflowService
@Service public class KfePsbtWorkflowService extends Object
Coordinates a cold-wallet PSBT from creation through offline signing, transaction finalization, and broadcast, binding the signed transaction to the destination, amount, and originally approved inputs.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfePsbtWorkflowService

      public KfePsbtWorkflowService(KfePsbtWorkflowRepository workflowRepository, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<BitcoinCoreRpcClient> bitcoinCoreRpcClientProvider, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, KfeHashService hashService, KfeAuditLogService auditLogService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeColdWalletObservationService> coldObservationService)
      Creates the PSBT workflow coordinator.
      Parameters:
      workflowRepository - persistence and ownership-scoped workflow lookup
      bitcoinCoreRpcClientProvider - optional decode/finalize/broadcast RPC provider
      objectMapper - JSON support for the approved input list and decoded transaction
      hashService - payload hash provider
      auditLogService - audit writer
      coldObservationService - optional history and confirmation observer

  • Method Details

    • create

      @Transactional public KfePsbtWorkflowEntity create(Long userId, UUID walletId, String psbt, String psbtHash, long feeSats, long amountSats, String destinationAddress, List<KfeColdWalletPsbtRequest.Input> inputs)
      Persists an unsigned PSBT workflow in CREATED state, including the approved inputs needed to bind a later offline-signed PSBT, then records a creation audit event.
      Parameters:
      userId - owning user
      walletId - cold/watch-only wallet used for the spend
      psbt - unsigned PSBT returned by Bitcoin Core funding
      psbtHash - hash of the original unsigned PSBT
      feeSats - estimated transaction fee in satoshis
      amountSats - requested destination amount in satoshis
      destinationAddress - approved recipient address
      inputs - outpoints authorized for the transaction
      Returns:
      persisted workflow entity

    • attachSignedPsbt

      @Transactional public KfePsbtWorkflowResponse attachSignedPsbt(Long userId, UUID workflowId, KfeSignedPsbtRequest request)
      Validates and attaches an offline-signed PSBT, requiring its destination, amount, and inputs to match the workflow before Bitcoin Core finalization. Complete finalization stores raw transaction bytes and transitions to FINALIZED; incomplete signing remains SIGNED.
      Parameters:
      userId - workflow owner
      workflowId - workflow identifier
      request - signed PSBT supplied by the offline signer
      Returns:
      updated workflow response
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for missing signed data or a transaction-binding mismatch
      IllegalStateException - when the workflow was already broadcast

    • broadcast

      @Transactional public KfePsbtWorkflowResponse broadcast(Long userId, UUID workflowId)
      Broadcasts a finalized raw transaction for the owning user; an already broadcast workflow is idempotently returned. Successful RPC submission persists txid/status, best-effort records cold history, and audits the result; an RPC failure marks the workflow FAILED and is rethrown.
      Parameters:
      userId - workflow owner
      workflowId - workflow identifier
      Returns:
      broadcast workflow response
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the workflow is not owned by the user
      IllegalStateException - when raw transaction finalization has not completed
